title: Risk assessment of mental stress (longitudinal survey)
summary: An online employee survey with tree measurement points (longitudinal survey)  will be conducted to evaluate the impact of New Work structures on employees health. There will be a special focus on flexibility, virtuality, decentralization, agility and on the perception of the company's internal transformation process.
conditions: general health, burnout, depressiveness in a non-clinical context, mental and physical stress symptoms

interventions.name: An online employee survey with three measurement points within two years will be conducted in a German software company (currently approx. 5000 employees).
